# opalstack_psqluser (Data Source)

Looks up a PostgreSQL user by `id` or by `name`. Its password is never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_psqluser" "wiki" {
  name = "wiki"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the user.
- `name` (String) Name of the user.

### Read-Only

- `external` (Boolean) Whether the user may connect from outside the server.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the user lives on.
